decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The display of the advertisement hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 4 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.
Condition : 7 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant planning permission.
Condition : 8 - The street number of the property shall be displayed on the fascia hereby approved.

Condition : 9 - No advertisment shall be sited or displayed so as to obscure, or hinder, the ready interpretation of any road sign, railway sign or aid to navigation by water or air so as to otherwise render hazardous the use of any highway, railway, waterway ( including any coastal waters) or aerodrome (civil or military).

Condition : 10 - The application for the installation of shop fascia sign, illuminated with concealed halo lighting, as shown on drawing, 696/01/01, 696/02/02 REVA, received 10th February 2006, would, by reason of its size, position and design, be of satisfactory appearance and would not be detrimental to the appearance of the building and street scene and have no impact on public safety. The proposal would comply with policies, ENV-B.1.1 New Development and ENV-B.1.4 Advertisements of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.
description: Display of new fascia sign to shopfront
